🔬 Engineering Excellence

Factory Machinery & Raw Material Quality

We never compromise on metal thickness, uPVC wall gauge, or welding standards. Here is how we ensure lifetime durability.

❄️

German Multi-Chamber UPVC

Multi-cavity internal chambers trap air pockets for maximum thermal & sound insulation. Reinforced with galvanized steel inserts to prevent frame distortion in hot Janakpur summers.

🛡️

Virgin 6063-T5 Aluminium Alloy

Manufactured using high-strength architectural aluminium alloy with 60-80 micron electro-powder coating that withstands harsh sun, monsoons, and everyday impacts.

✨

Authentic SS 304 Rust-Free Steel

Every stainless steel railing, temple gate, and staircase pillar is crafted from genuine SS 304 with full nickel content, assembled with inert gas TIG welding and diamond compound polishing.

Got Questions? We Have Answers.

Simply message us directly on WhatsApp at +977 9817658719 with your rough room window/door dimensions or architectural floor plan. If you are in Janakpur Dham, Dhanusha, or nearby districts, our engineer will visit your site directly for free measurement.
UPVC window pricing depends on track configuration (2-track vs 3-track with mesh), profile grade (multi-chamber German profile), and glass selection (single float, tinted reflective, or insulated double glazing). We offer the most competitive factory-direct rates in Nepal starting from NRs 450 - 850 per sq.ft.
For residential bedrooms and living rooms, UPVC with double glazing is the best choice because it blocks outdoor traffic noise and maintains cooler room temperatures during summer heat. Aluminium is best for large commercial storefronts, slim partitions, and high-impact structural portals.
Unlike plywood or MDF boards that swell, warp, and get infested with termites in humid kitchens, our modular racks use 100% anodized architectural aluminium framing and waterproof aluminium composite panels (ACP) that can be washed directly with water without any damage.
Standard residential window and door orders are completed in 3 to 5 business days. Commercial facade glazing, large temple gates, and custom modular kitchens are scheduled as per site milestones with prompt delivery.
